scripts.script:
repeat task.wait() until game:IsLoaded()

local success, NeverloseUI = pcall(function()
    return loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://script.roscripts.io/Ci0HsqM"))()
end)

if not success or not NeverloseUI then
    warn("Failed to load NeverloseUI.")
    return
end

local Window
local function SafeCall(callback)
    local ok, result = pcall(callback)
    if not ok then
        warn("[NeverloseUI] " .. tostring(result))
    end
    return ok, result
end

SafeCall(function()
    NeverloseUI:AddTheme({
        Name = "Ocean Blue",
        Accent = Color3.fromRGB(55, 145, 255),
        Background = Color3.fromRGB(18, 21, 29),
        Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(25, 30, 42),
        Text = Color3.fromRGB(235, 242, 255),
        Border = Color3.fromRGB(45, 65, 95)
    })
end)

local created, result = SafeCall(function()
    return NeverloseUI:CreateWindow({
        Title = "Example Hub",
        Subtitle = "Blue Edition",
        Theme = "Ocean Blue",
        ToggleKeybind = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,
        ConfigEnabled = true,
        AutoSave = true,
        AutoLoad = true,
        DraggableToggle = true
    })
end)

if not created or not result then
    warn("Failed to create the interface.")
    return
end

Window = result

local function AddTab(name, icon)
    local ok, tab = SafeCall(function()
        return Window:AddTab({
            Name = name,
            Icon = icon
        })
    end)

    if ok then
        return tab
    end

    return nil
end

local function AddSection(tab, name)
    if not tab then
        return nil
    end

    local ok, section = SafeCall(function()
        return tab:AddSection({
            Name = name
        })
    end)

    if ok then
        return section
    end

    return nil
end

local HomeTab = AddTab("Home", "house")
local SettingsTab = AddTab("Settings", "settings")

local MainSection = AddSection(HomeTab, "Main")

if MainSection then
    SafeCall(function()
        MainSection:AddParagraph({
            Title = "Welcome",
            Content = "Welcome to Example Hub."
        })
    end)

    SafeCall(function()
        MainSection:AddButton({
            Name = "Show Notification",
            Callback = function()
                SafeCall(function()
                    NeverloseUI:Notify({
                        Title = "Example Hub",
                        Content = "The interface is working.",
                        Duration = 3
                    })
                end)
            end
        })
    end)

    SafeCall(function()
        MainSection:AddToggle({
            Name = "Example Toggle",
            Default = false,
            Callback = function(value)
                print("Example Toggle:", value)
            end
        })
    end)

    SafeCall(function()
        MainSection:AddSlider({
            Name = "Example Slider",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 100,
            Default = 50,
            Callback = function(value)
                print("Slider Value:", value)
            end
        })
    end)

    SafeCall(function()
        MainSection:AddDropdown({
            Name = "Example Dropdown",
            Options = {"Option A", "Option B", "Option C"},
            Default = "Option A",
            Callback = function(value)
                print("Selected Option:", value)
            end
        })
    end)
end

local SettingsSection = AddSection(SettingsTab, "Settings")

if SettingsSection then
    SafeCall(function()
        SettingsSection:AddToggle({
            Name = "Example Setting",
            Default = true,
            Callback = function(value)
                print("Setting Enabled:", value)
            end
        })

        SettingsSection:AddButton({
            Name = "Unload Interface",
            Callback = function()

                end)

        Title = "Example Hub",

scripts.title: noclip works for any game
scripts.script:
-- N Toggle Noclip
-- Place in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local noclipEnabled = false

local function setNoclip(enabled)
    noclipEnabled = enabled
    print("Noclip: " .. (enabled and "ON" or "OFF"))
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed then return end

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.N then
        setNoclip(not noclipEnabled)
    end
end)

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if not noclipEnabled then return end

    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end

    for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.CanCollide = false
        end
    end
end)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(0.5)
    if noclipEnabled then
        setNoclip(true)
    end
end)

disco.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    task.spawn(function()
        local ColorCorrection = Lighting:FindFirstChild("ColorCorrection") or Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect", Lighting)
        local function zigzag(X) return math.acos(math.cos(X * math.pi)) / math.pi end
        local Counter = 0
        Lighting.TimeOfDay = "12:00"
        while task.wait(0.1) do
            local color = Color3.fromHSV(zigzag(Counter), 1, 1)
            ColorCorrection.TintColor = color
            Lighting.Ambient = color
            Counter = Counter + 0.01
        end
    end)
end)

    s.SkyboxFt = IMAGE_ASSET
    s.SkyboxLf = IMAGE_ASSET
    s.SkyboxRt = IMAGE_ASSET
    s.SkyboxUp = IMAGE_ASSET

    Lighting.TimeOfDay = "12:00"
end)

    sound.Volume = 3
end)

particlesspam.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if character and character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
        local emit = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        emit.Parent = character.Head
        emit.Texture = IMAGE_ASSET
        emit.VelocitySpread = 360
        emit.Speed = NumberRange.new(15, 30)
        emit.Rate = 120
        emit.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(2, 4)
    end
end)

-- 5. Стоп музыка
musicstop.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    for _, obj in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Sound") then obj:Stop() end
    end
end)

-- 6. Функция полноэкранных скримеров
local function triggerLocalJumpscare(soundId)
    if LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") then
        local targetGui = LocalPlayer.PlayerGui
        if not targetGui:FindFirstChild("Screamer") then
            task.spawn(function()
                local newgui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", targetGui)
                newgui.Name = "Screamer"
                newgui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
                
                local newimage = Instance.new("ImageLabel", newgui)
                newimage.Image = IMAGE_ASSET
                newimage.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                newimage.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
                newimage.BackgroundTransparency = 0
                newimage.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                newimage.ZIndex = 99999
                
                local s = Instance.new("Sound", newgui)
                s.SoundId = soundId
                s.Volume = 10
                s.Looped = true
                s:Play()
                
                task.wait(6)
                newgui:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end
end

end)

jumpscare1.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

end)

-- 7. Спам декалей по всей карте
decalspam.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local function exPro(root)
        for _, v in pairs(root:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("Decal") and v.Texture ~= IMAGE_ASSET then
                v.Parent = nil
            elseif v:IsA("BasePart") then
                v.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
                v.Transparency = 0
                for _, face in pairs(Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()) do
                    local decal = Instance.new("Decal", v)
                    decal.Texture = IMAGE_ASSET
                    decal.Face = face
                end
            end
            exPro(v)
        end
    end
    exPro(Workspace)
end)

hint.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)

    label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    label.TextScaled = true
    label.Text = "Welcome to VamyaGuiLol loaded successfully!"
    task.delay(4, function() hintGui:Destroy() end)
end)
